# 1337Ops

> Enterprise AI Automation, Cloud Architecture, and Security Solutions. Scale without increasing headcount.

1337Ops delivers expert technology consultation, custom AI agent workflows (n8n, LangChain, LangGraph), cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Terraform), VoIP, Starlink setup, cybersecurity penetration testing (CEH), web development, and project management. Founded by Payton Forristal-Garcia (AWS SAA, CEH, CSM).

## Core Services

- [IT Consultation](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Strategic technology roadmaps, vendor evaluation, and digital transformation.
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Custom AI workflows, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agents using n8n, LangChain, and LangGraph.
- [Network Design & Support](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Resilient LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, and secure hybrid cloud networking.
- [VoIP Solutions](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Enterprise cloud PBX, SIP trunking, and unified communications (3CX, FreePBX, Teams).
- [Website Design & Development](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Performant, accessible web apps and marketing sites (React, Next.js, Astro).
- [CyberSecurity Engagements](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Red/Blue/Purple team penetration testing by CEH-certified professionals.
- [Starlink Setup & Configuration](https://1337ops.tech/#services): End-to-end high-speed satellite internet deployment for remote locations.
- [Project Management](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Agile/Scrum delivery, PMO governance, and technical leadership.
- [Graphic Design](https://1337ops.tech/#services): Brand identity, UI/UX systems, and digital marketing assets.
